name: items
description: The links. Each may contain its own `items` for one level of nesting.

name: heading
description: Heading above the list, for example the section or case reference.

name: ariaLabel
description: Accessible name for the navigation landmark. Defaults to `Side navigation`.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the navigation.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes to add to the navigation.
